# Asher Aw

> Asher Aw is a Singapore-based theatre actor, communications coach and storyteller. 15+ years in marketing, 10+ years on stage. He writes about authenticity, AI experiments, theatre, faith, marketing and personal development.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://asheraw.com/): who Asher is, his stage work, coaching and faith
- [Blog](https://asheraw.com/blog): essays, stories and lessons
- [Connect](https://asheraw.com/connect): all the ways to reach Asher
- [Privacy](https://asheraw.com/privacy): what the site collects and why

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://asheraw.com/sitemap.xml): every public page
